title: 2k/3 I need to make Tenna Dance

posts.author: CaptainGooby
posts.body: I am trying to add Tenna to my RPG Maker 2003 game, and it's going well, I have him at full scale, he's capable of moving around and he's capable of switching from one pose to another, and there's a feature called 'Spritesheet' in the Show Image function which allows the use of a large image with a spritesheet containing (in my case) an animation, and it allows it to animate, however when I turn on the animation, Tenna just sits there on the first frame of his Dance animation instead of actually animating during gameplay, I was wondering how to fix this issue and make him actually show his animation.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: Perhaps you keep starting the anination, thereby resetting it to frame 1, in a never-ending loop, because your event is set to parallel process or autostart without a switch and second page to turn it off once it ran once?
